title: Copilot Studio: share workflows with co-owners for collaborative editing
notes: claim 62: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing says workflow runs stop when prepaid capacity is exhausted, but Microsoft now says they stop when the environment has no Copilot Credits available, including its overage sources. The roadmap facts and both documented control operations are supported; the capacity API pre-check is a false alarm.

claims.fix: Append ' > environment > Copilot Credits' to the existing capacity UI path. Add to its note: 'The panel's overage settings are Capacity overages > Draw from the available capacity in my tenant and Capacity overages > Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan.'

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: capacity API
claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes environment credit allocations and tenant-pool draw configuration.
claims.quote:
$apiBaseUrl    = "https://api.powerplatform.com"
$apiVersion    = "2024-10-01"
...
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"
claims.fix: Keep the call; the pre-check missed its interpolated URL. Add to controls[1].note: 'The request sets scope.environmentId and allocatedEntitlements with entitlementId MCSMessages, allocation.quantity, and enforcementRules containing ruleType TenantPool and enabled. This example configures tenant-pool draw, not the pay-as-you-go overage option.'
